verdict.rationale: AgentOS is documented as a toolkit, with an official MCP server, that lets AI agents act on a production Airwallex account: reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards and building cashflow reports. A user can therefore drive the account in natural language, but only through a third-party agent client. The developer connector covers only docs and sandbox access for coding agents, not live operation. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the product itself, detail on which operations AgentOS exposes, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.
